title: NFL Logo Quiz Part 3: Hard Mode
headline: NFL Logo Quiz Part 3: Name The Team From A Tiny Piece Of Its Logo
description: A hard NFL logo quiz: eight tiny pieces of NFL team logos, about 2% of each logo. Guess the team, tap to reveal the answer, keep score and share your result.
intro: Every piece below is a small square cut from a current NFL team logo, about one fiftieth of the whole mark. No full letters, no team names, no giveaways. Each piece still holds one real detail, a color pair, a curve or an edge that belongs to only one team.
Make your guess, then tap Show The Answer. Be honest and mark whether you got it, and your score adds up at the bottom.

items.piece: Black spots on the gold coat of the jaguar's head.
items.fact: The Jaguars unveiled this redrawn jaguar head on February 5, 2013, replacing the original 1995 version.

items.piece: The red ring around the logo and the edge of the light blue circle.
items.fact: The Titans unveiled a new logo in March 2026. It keeps the T and the three stars for the state but drops the flames from the 1999 logo.

items.piece: Red and white stripes running into the navy of the Patriot's hat.
items.fact: The Flying Elvis logo debuted for the 1993 season. NFL Properties built it in a few months to replace Pat Patriot.

items.piece: The white inner border where two points of the star meet at the bottom.
items.fact: The Cowboys' star was a plain solid shape in 1960. The white line and blue border around it were added in 1964.

items.piece: The gold border at the top left corner of the W, against burgundy.
items.fact: Washington introduced this W on February 2, 2022, the day the team became the Commanders.

items.piece: The back of the green jet that flies above the lettering, with the tops of the letters below.
items.fact: In April 2024 the Jets brought back a modern version of their 1978 to 1997 logo, with a jet flying above the word JETS.

items.piece: Silver, black and white feathers on the back of the eagle's head.
items.fact: The Eagles introduced this eagle head in 1996, the same year they switched from kelly green to midnight green.

items.piece: The inside corner where the y's stem curves into its long tail.
items.fact: The lowercase ny first went on Giants helmets in 1961 and was dropped in 1975. An updated version came back as the primary logo in 2000.
